summary: Nokia Corporation filed a Form 6-K announcing the issuance of EUR 500 million senior unsecured notes under its EMTN programme. The notes mature on 5 June 2032, bear a 3.625% fixed annual coupon, and will be listed on Euronext Dublin. Proceeds are for general corporate purposes, including refinancing EUR 500 million of 3.125% notes due May 2028 via make-whole redemption. This is a routine debt capital markets transaction, not a special situation.
